name: Dr. Sazzad Hussan
intro: More than a decade in active clinical practice, caring for thousands of patients. A diabetes specialist dedicated to thoughtful, ongoing care in Gazipur.
biography: Dr. Sazzad Hussan’s experience has been built in the consultation room: more than 10 years of active practice and care for thousands of patients. As a diabetes specialist in Gazipur, he focuses on diabetes management while drawing on his wider experience in general medicine.

As a Medical Officer at Diabetic Somity Gazipur, he brings extensive outpatient experience to everyday clinical practice. Alongside his clinical work, he participates in medical seminars, professional meetings and international conferences.
